name: Marymount Open 2010
information: Registration starts at 8 and the first event starts at 8:30. Please be ready to solve when your name is called. Due to time constraints, there are cut-offs for Square-1, 4x4, and OH. The cost is $15 for as many events you want to compete in. There will be an additional $1 fee from each competitor to go to the WCA. Registration will also be at the door for the same price.
